tickets.title: [product_regression] test_invoice_rounding_matches_ledger failed on a1b2c3
tickets.description: The test `test_invoice_rounding_matches_ledger` failed due to an assertion error comparing the calculated invoice total against the expected ledger total. This is likely a product regression caused by the recent change in `src/billing/tax_calculator.py` that simplified the VAT calculation. The change introduced a discrepancy in the rounding logic, leading to an unexpected total.
